assets.name: coronation-of-mary-with-six-angels-and-throne
assets.description: The coronation of Mary with Christ, six angels and their shared architectural throne. Part of the Beffi Coronation frame set.

provenance.title: Leaf from an Antiphonary: Coronation of the Virgin
provenance.artist: Master of the Beffi Triptych (Italian, active 1390–1425)

extraction.prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Extract the ENTIRE original contacting scene: Christ crowning Mary, all FOUR standing angels, BOTH foreground kneeling angels and the source-visible peaked architectural throne. Keep the original two kneeling angels IN FRONT of the throne so the hidden lower arches stay hidden exactly as in the source. NO newly completed arches or hidden legs. Preserve every actual throne fragment, wing and long green wing tip, robe, crown and halo. Remove flat orange floor, flat gold background, rectangular outer miniature rule and all outer page ornament. Genuine architecture openings and actual gaps between figures clear; painted stone, clothing and halos opaque. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.

native_subject_size_evidence.method: Individually inspected native visible subject bounds, excluding input-region whitespace and neighbours.

extraction.subject_resolution_cap_method: Both subject axes capped to inspected native subject bounds; input-region whitespace cannot permit subject upscaling.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

review.notes: Each complete original ROI, white and dark proof inspected. Coronation retains Christ, Mary, six angels and their actual shared throne, clears the floor/gold field and real architectural openings; two foreground kneelers also already available separately. Angel retains all original wing, white scroll and blue/white clouds while starry sky/arch cleared. Both small leaf terminals retain their actual pale/colored folds and original silhouettes without invented branches.

Preserve every gold medallion, interwoven blue knot, six-pointed star, leaf, fine hanging droplet and tiny blue bead; gold fields within the actual ornaments remain opaque with original wear. Preserve exact asymmetric original arrangement and geometry; do not simplify, omit detached small ornaments, repair worn paint, duplicate or add ornaments. Clear central religious miniature including its own rectangular gilt/green border, musical staff, all lettering, and parchment between ornaments and through their real holes. The outer frame ornament alone remains, with genuinely transparent interior and exterior. Faithful historical paint texture and original colors; no redesigned details, no symmetrical replacement. Maintain original proportions and all source-visible extremities. Large detailed output.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: AI alpha ownership reference only. Delivered paint is native source RGB; ray ink is source-measured tone and coverage, with no generated RGB.

review.notes: Corrected omission of peripheral sunbursts, including the two upper-left circles missing from the earlier extraction. All 47 scoped sunbursts checked against the original; original rays recovered and intervening parchment removed by local ink unmixing. Whole frame reviewed on white/dark. Paint remains source-native; gold, leaf tips, knots, stars and pendants retained. Historical wear and physically source-clipped top/righthand ray ends remain as original.
